source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
I just completed 2 mints (accidently).
For the first one, I referred to #5 and included a $1 tip, but the tip did not work - 0x0eab3ba1e91f99ac6e86793487046e3632f735c6661abff6c8e33800abc6559e

For the second one, I used no referral code, but neither the ticket nor the commission for it is appearing on the leaderboard - 0xfd5bd846b2543da486211a72fcecd178be8a3bee966b34823636648e897bf9ea

execution.observed_behavior: A completed mint using referral code #5 and a selected $1 tip did not process the tip.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
I just completed a mint using 'no referral code' and adding a '$1 tip'.

[ACCOUNT_001] Tipping still isn't working.

[ACCOUNT_001] Tickets and commissions from 'no referral code' purchases are still not appearing on the leaderboard or in the NFT attributes.

Also, after I minted, a second transaction popped up (shown in the screenshot). I cancelled it, but the mint still worked fine.
Do you know why that second transaction appeared? Was it for the tip?

execution.observed_behavior: On a no-referral mint with a selected $1 tip, the mint succeeded but the tip did not; an unexpected second transaction appeared and was canceled.

value_updates.tip_transaction_interaction: optional manual action in the mint-success modal with no automatic transaction prompt

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
okay, i completed a mint using 'no referral code' with a '$1 tip'.

The mint required me to execute 1 transaction - 0xc92e17e9e7f26e6b4e03093ce35f6ed3d7fc135c8ee00bc77357eb082779f715

Immediately afterward, another transaction appeared for the tip - 0x887c21856bddc283cd444881931a1d14469cbbd49c2c2764e15855a9181af3b0

(We will need to add a UI note informing buyers that the tip transaction comes immediately after the mint transaction.)

Also, it may have been obscured by the tip transaction, but i did not see the 'mint successful' modal.

And there was no new commission or ticket counted on the leaderboard.

execution.observed_behavior: A separate tip transaction opened immediately after the mint instead of being presented through the accepted manual, non-automatic success-modal interaction.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
Another important detail from your case:
Your “$1 tip” tx became a self-transfer because the on-chain founderWallet is currently your wallet, meaning that tipping yourself does not move any funds. I deployed a UI safeguard that disables tips when this situation occurs.

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer reports deploying a UI safeguard that disables tipping when the buyer wallet is also the configured founder wallet, preventing a no-op self-transfer.
Client confirms receipt of the $3 tip sent from the freelancer's mint.
